Clostridial neurotoxin disrupts inhibitory neurotransmission. Muscle spasms reflect neurologic dysfunction rather than primary muscle damage.
Prader-Willi neurodevelopmental and hypothalamic endocrine syndrome; developmental delay, hyperphagia and obesity are common.
Inflammation of the penile glans and prepuce is confined to reproductive anatomy; the umbrella concept does not establish an infectious or autoimmune cause.
